description: Is a stock market open, and when does it change? Defaults to the US. Pass exchange (an EODHD code: XETRA, F, LSE, PA, AS, BR, LS, MI, MC, SW, CO, ST, HE, OL, VI, IR) or a symbol with that suffix (SAP.XETRA) for a European exchange. Returns the current session (pre_market, open, after_hours or closed; European exchanges have only open and closed), whether today is a trading day, any holiday or early close, the trading day's windows as ISO instants, and the next session change. Render the instants in the user's own timezone.

exchange.description: EODHD exchange code, e.g. XETRA or LSE. Default US.

symbol.description: A ticker; its suffix picks the exchange (SAP.XETRA). Ignored when exchange is set.

name: get_market_status
